Searched the catalog · Hammer Miner Thor P2 Magic Miner 40T Harlo B30

Got it — so not your first rig. Two 40Ts is already 80 TH.

The T. P2 is live at $369 (down from $449), 10 TH at ~166 W, ~40 dB. Next to your 40Ts it's small, but it's the quiet one you can leave in a bedroom or office.

What are you after with a third box — more hashrate, or something quieter you can run somewhere else in the house?
Searched the catalog · Harlo H15 Dual

Straight answer: the H15 isn't buyable yet. $999, 15 TH SHA-256 plus 1.08 GH/s scrypt for DOGE/LTC, ~450 W, and the drop date hasn't been announced. I can't hold or reserve one — a drop sells to whoever checks out first. Notify me on the page is the only way in.

If the dual-algo DOGE side is what's pulling you, that's the only unit that does both. If it's just more BTC hashrate, the B30 is $899 for 30 TH and buyable today.

Which one is it — the Dogecoin half, or the hashrate?
